verdict.rationale: Authy's own features page says the app captures 2FA QR codes from major services and protects and serves the resulting 2FA tokens, even offline. Community users confirm they generate 2FA codes from it day to day. The Authy API deprecation concerns the developer API, not the consumer app's QR enrollment. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the QR-scan-to-code flow, evidence that codes appear immediately after scanning, and explicit hands-on corroboration of QR enrollment.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Easily capture 2FA QR codes from Facebook, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Dropbox and many more.
